description.intro: Children's long pants are your ideal ally for training or moving with ease on a daily basis. Designed with functional fabrics and ergonomic cut, it offers you comfort, style and freedom of action.
key_benefits: Thermal comfort: Ideal for demanding training in variable climates.
Ventilation panels: Promotes air circulation to keep you dry.
Technical cut: Slim design that allows natural movements.
Estilo y funcionalidad: Escudo del Manchester City y detalles modernos.
